title: Fix all in project
summary: Applies autofixes for every fixable finding across the whole project, starting from the Structure form
intro: Read this when you want every auto-fixable finding in the whole project resolved in one action. In the Structure form right-click the Diagnostics root and choose Fix all in project; it is not on the main menu and runs lint-all --fix --apply, so it can rewrite many files.

surfaces.caption: Fix all in project
steps: Open the Structure form (drag-lint > Show Structure)
Choose Fix all in project (it is not on the main menu)

flags.name: --quiet
flags.summary: suppress per-file progress lines written to stderr

pitfalls: lint `<file>` is a strict SUBSET: project-wide rules can only fire in lint-all.

questions.ask: How do I fix every auto-fixable finding in the whole project?
Are naming fixes included, and how do I switch one off?
questions.command: drag-lint lint-all --db <file.sqlite> --fix --apply   (naming renames are included; list a rule in "autofix_off" in drag-lint-lint.json to withhold it)
